_comment: aamod anchor map for Astral Ascent (Chowdren v1388, build 25330514).
Each entry names an engine function by string literals that function references.
The same literals are what mods pass to AAModAPI::anchor_find at runtime;
`expect` is the RVA this build resolves to, so a mismatch or a MISSING entry
means the game changed and the anchors need re-mining (see docs/engine-notes.md).

platform_create_display.notes: creates the window/context; called from 0x615330 and 0x615a00

image_loader_message.notes: one of three clusters: the plain literal is also a prefix of the longer 'Could not load image "%s": %s' message used elsewhere

game_mod_loader.source: v1388-only strings (not in the 2016 source snapshot)
game_mod_loader.notes: the game's own Steam Workshop downloader; aamod must stay out of its way rather than replace it

overlay_imgui_setup.notes: sets ImGui io.IniFilename/LogFilename; called only from 0x5cdbb0, which is called only from 0x7c010 (itself reached through the .rdata table slot 0x5934230)
